correctness.rationale: For the closed-neighborhood/radius-one Čech complex of K_q□K_q (q≥3), every maximal face is contained in row a ∪ column b. The invariant row/column subcomplex has H1≅U⊗U and coordinate exchange acts by negative flip. The prescribed unique-cross-center acyclic pairing reduces mixed faces to a relative chain module with two triangles over each diagonal edge; relative H2 is a signed permutation module and connecting boundaries of rectangles surject onto H1. The resulting exact rational H2 character is 2 C(fσ,2) C(fτ,2)+2tσtτ−(fσ−1)(fτ−1); for exchange it is −(f(στ)−1)^2. Relative invariants are 1d under Sq×Sq but exchange reverses them. Independently reconstructed all faces and oriented Lefschetz traces for q=2,3,4 and all 1232 group elements, confirming formulas; all q follows the uniform Morse/relative proof.

originality.rationale: Matsushita’s Examples 3.5 and 5.7 already identify the same closed-neighborhood rook-graph object and determine the nonequivariant wedge rank and simple connectivity. Neither those results nor general Čech-complex topology supplies the full wreath-product character or the sign under coordinate interchange. Other Resultary rook-graph findings about OPEN neighborhood, three-cut and independence complexes have different simplicial definitions; their invariants cannot be substituted.
